string.text: Enables the optional visual presentation addon. It reads Framework state and never changes composure.

Subtle uses vignette only. Default adds limited blur and darkness. Cinematic permits configured FOV and generic event effects. Combat reactions work in Subtle, Default, and Cinematic; Accessibility suppresses combat camera motion and strongly reduces the edge pulse.
Darkens and expands the screen edges while keeping the center clear.
Auto uses the passive UI overlay and falls back to vignette_control. UI Overlay never captures input. Console / Shader uses only vignette_control.
Scales edge darkness independently, from disabled to strongly amplified.
Controls how far the clear-center edge effect spreads inward as Composure falls.
Safety cap for the passive edge overlay. The center remains clear.
Allows low-strength full-screen stock blur below 40 composure. No blur is used at Medium-Low.
Scales the secondary stock PPE blur.
Allows a tightly capped dark overlay below 40 composure.
Hard cap for continuous darkness. Night, underground, and night-vision compatibility flags reduce it further.
Gradually narrows FOV below the configured start value. Disabled by default.
Composure threshold where smooth FOV narrowing begins.
Maximum reduction in degrees, from 0 to 15. Six is the suggested default and ten is cinematic.
Allows alcohol and psy pulses requested by other modules. Effective only in Cinematic profile.
Allows short fatigue and shell-shock camera events. Effective only in Cinematic profile.
Plays one short fatigue pulse when entering Breaking Point. Requires Cinematic profile and camera pulses.
Listens to Composure Combat near-miss and actor-hit events and presents short visual reactions. This never changes Composure or combat detection.
Scales near-miss and hit reactions from disabled to amplified. Reactions also grow automatically as current Composure falls.
Flashes a clear-center edge pulse immediately on hostile bullet near misses and human hits. The pulse then fades through the normal Visuals update loop.
Scales only the normal near-miss screen-edge pulse. Does not change camera movement.
Scales only the extreme near-miss screen-edge pulse. Does not change camera movement.
Scales only the screen-edge pulse when a hostile human bullet actually hits the actor.
Scales the duration of combat edge pulses from half duration to double duration without changing camera duration.
Uses a tiny fatigue jolt for normal near misses, a stronger shock pulse for extreme near misses, and a short shell-shock pulse when hit. Accessibility profile suppresses combat camera motion.
Previews Visuals without changing the Framework composure value. Disable after testing.
Zero previews the 55 threshold and 100 previews near Breaking Point.
Writes current targets, renderer state, FOV ownership, and compatibility flags to the X-Ray log. Default: F5.
How often targets are refreshed from the Framework snapshot. Effects interpolate between targets.
Writes extra Visuals diagnostics to the X-Ray log. Module failures are always logged.
